text: Sir, I have read every line of the Principia, twice, and I shall thank you not to interrupt me again. Observe the apple. It falls, as it has always fallen, and I see no reason to apologise for it.

ambrose.instruct: A proud English man of about sixty-five with a crisp, formal, proud voice and a refined English accent, noticeably low in pitch, measured and clipped, clear and precise, like a stern old professor correcting a student.
